answer: Give each identity a modest starting reward ceiling and raise it only after unrelated peers audit random samples against signed source records. Merge accounts that reuse reviewers or recycle work and cap the cluster as one participant. For example, compare a jetty inspection to dated structural photos, trace a velvet textile lot to its lab record, or verify a beacon alert against timestamped device logs. A Sybil attacker has to supply distinct, checkable work and earn separate trust rather than multiply keys.
